items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from hit in Week 1; monitored throughout week.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 2; potential absence boosts other LAC WRs.
items.opportunity: Monitor practice; slot role if out.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game. MRI upcoming; coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated but not serious per sources.
items.implication: Likely plays or limited Week 2 vs NO; Bateman/Lane elevated if out.
items.opportunity: Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist multi-game out.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown high ankle sprain, no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks; placed on IR.
items.implication: Long-term absence; NE WR depth up.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Only RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13; looked extremely healthy. Great matchup vs CLE.
items.why: Goal-line and route work dominant; healthy.
items.implication: RB1 upside locked; Gainwell clear backup.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup; working hard to return.
items.implication: Possible Week 2 return; Mayer filled in with 6 catches.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE upside if Bowers limited/out.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne not full lead; Kamara return further dilutes.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 52% snaps (36/69), 71% routes (24/34), 31% targets (9), 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Decided 2 hours before kickoff; family didn't attend due to uncertainty.
items.implication: Healthy return validates start; target share elite.
items.opportunity: 71% routes despite snap limit; full role imminent.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but wouldn't activate if worried about ankle. Starting him everywhere.
items.why: Cardinals activated; ankle concern but playing.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with risk; ETR expected him.
items.opportunity: Lead back role with Conner on IR.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY; Etienne projections linked to absence.
Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.implication: Core four locked elite; ignore depth.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays. Want all the Loveland, buying low.
items.why: Elite route share despite production miss.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid over PCL: 74% snaps (42/57), 69% routes (22/32 on Allen dropbacks). Moves needle when on field.
items.why: Full recovery from PCL; high involvement.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps; Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks off to side early week allegedly groin.
Isaiah Likely breakout season well under way.
